description: This file defines a WindowState class for managing and persisting window size, position, and display state in an Electron application, including handling window bounds, visibility, and state restoration.

classes.name: WindowState
classes.description: A class to manage window size, position, and display state, with methods to save, restore, and validate window bounds in an Electron app.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes WindowState with optional configuration, loads previous state, and validates it.

methods.name: isNormal
methods.description: Checks if the window is in a normal (not maximized, minimized, or full screen) state.

methods.name: hasBounds
methods.description: Checks if the current window bounds are valid.

methods.name: resetStateToDefault
methods.description: Resets window state to default size and position based on primary display.

methods.name: windowWithinBounds
methods.description: Checks if the window is within given display bounds.

methods.name: ensureWindowVisibleOnSomeDisplay
methods.description: Ensures the window is visible on at least one display, resets if not.

methods.name: validateState
methods.description: Validates the current window state, resets if invalid, and ensures visibility.

methods.name: updateState
methods.description: Updates internal state with current window bounds and display info.

methods.name: saveState
methods.description: Saves the current window state to persistent storage.

methods.name: stateChangeHandler
methods.description: Handles resize/move events with debounce to save state.

methods.name: closeHandler
methods.description: Handles window close event to update state.

methods.name: closedHandler
methods.description: Handles window closed event, unregisters listeners, and saves state.

methods.name: manage
methods.description: Attaches event listeners to a BrowserWindow and restores its previous state.

methods.name: unmanage
methods.description: Removes event listeners from the window.
